Integrate the Place List API into the new design (Discover Places / place search). Wire into src/api/places.ts behind the store status/error seam (mock to live).

API

  • Postman: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/26723813/2sBXwqsBHS#0b32191d-217e-4de3-ba27-2753d4cd520c
  • {{base_url}}/places/list?limit=2&page=1&search=Sydney Opera House

Params

  • limit
  • page
  • search
  • include

Sub-tasks

  • Can search by location group
  • Can sort by most posts

Notes

  • typed model/DTO + cursor/page pagination
  • loading / empty / error states

QA Summary - 2026-08-14

Verdict: PASSED

Area Result Evidence
Real-device Dev retest PASS The retry flow loaded places, and selecting a place opened the Sukamulya detail with 4 360 posts and its post list.
API integration PASS The implementation calls GET /places/list through the typed API client and maps the response to the Home store.
Pagination and store state PASS (code review) The Home store sends page and limit, tracks total/hasMore, and owns loading, refresh, search, and error state.
Location-group search PASS (code review) The list request carries search; the place model preserves location_group_slug.
Most-posts sorting PASS (code review) The most-posts selection maps to API sort value most_posts.

Integrate the Place Detail API into the new design (place-detail screen). Wire into src/api/places.ts behind the store status/error seam (mock → live).

API

  • Postman: https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/26723813/2sBXwqsBHS#14663260-6e78-4224-8bb8-8fab6c5d22d8
  • GET /places/detail/:location_group_slug
  • example: {{base_url}}/places/detail/BAGB282c8c4c6a-lg20260605104956-bbb737a0d53d
  • spec: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#386

Param

  • include

Sub-tasks

  • allowed include filters:
    • location_name
    • location_post
    • thumbnail
    • total_posts
    • total_views

Notes

  • typed model/DTO; loading / empty / error states

Demo by Developer

WhatsApp.Video.2026-06-22.at.16.02.16.mp4

QA Summary - Issue #2667

Verdict: PASSED

The latest ui/components branch (009826b4a) was tested against the Dev environment with authenticated real tester data and a Dev-built Android application. No coding defects were found.

Scope and Result

Acceptance area Result Evidence
Place Detail API with include PASS Authenticated Dev request returned HTTP 200 and the requested location_name, location_post, thumbnail, total_posts, and total_views fields.
Posts integration PASS GET /places/detail/posts/:slug returned HTTP 200 with 9 real posts.
Contributors integration PASS GET /places/detail/contributors/:slug returned HTTP 200 with 3 real contributors.
Bookmark integration PASS GET /places/detail/bookmarks/:slug returned HTTP 200 with an empty list and total 0; the Dev app rendered the matching empty state.
Real-device detail mapping PASS Hospital Helipad opened in the Dev app with the API-backed name, address, 1 post, 1 view, and related post.
Loading / empty / error seam PASS (code review) The Zustand store owns per-slice status and error state for detail, posts, contributors, and bookmarks.

Real Dev API Evidence

Request Sanitized result
GET /places/detail/{location_group_slug}?include=location_name,location_post,thumbnail,total_posts,total_views HTTP 200; returned all requested fields.
GET /places/detail/{location_group_slug}/posts?page=1&limit=20&sort=latest_post HTTP 200; total: 9.
GET /places/detail/{location_group_slug}/contributors?page=1&limit=30 HTTP 200; total: 3.
GET /places/detail/{location_group_slug}/bookmarks?location_name=Hospital%20Helipad&page=1&limit=20 HTTP 200; total: 0, matching the empty UI state.
